quote: North Leamington Avenue in Chicago. Is that correct?
stewart_read: Rep read a wrong address from a bad record and had to be corrected, costing legitimacy points early even though customer stayed cooperative.
alternative_hypothesis: This could be a data/CRM error outside rep control rather than a rep failure.
coaching_implication: Verify address details with an open question before stating one confidently when confidence in the record is uncertain.

quote: But since my wife passed, I put my daughter on my insurance.
stewart_read: Customer disclosed his wife's death as a trust gift; rep replied only 'Alright. Perfect. That is good to know.' and moved straight to the program pitch.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have judged a brief acknowledgment as appropriately efficient given script pace and immediately-following co-owner question needs.
coaching_implication: A one-line acknowledgment ('I'm sorry for your loss') before continuing would have honored the disclosure without derailing the script.

quote: So I'm just gonna send you a text. And then could you take a picture of that bill that you're looking at and send that over to me?
stewart_read: Rep didn't check device comfort before committing to a photo-text path with an elderly customer, triggering avoidable friction.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may not have had any earlier signal that James would struggle, since he answered questions fine up to this point.
coaching_implication: Ask 'do you feel comfortable texting a photo, or would you rather read me the numbers' before starting the text flow.

quote: Well, maybe you call later on when one of my grandchildren here, they can, assist you or whatever because I don't know nothing about this.
stewart_read: This is the moment the pivot to verbal readback should have happened — instead the rep let another 20 seconds pass on the same broken path before offering the alternative.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep did pivot shortly after (15:01), so this could read as reasonably fast recovery rather than a miss.
coaching_implication: Treat a customer's suggestion to postpone as the hard signal to switch method immediately, not a few lines later.

quote: So since you have the bill in front of you, I'm just gonna have you read off the numbers to me instead.
stewart_read: Correct recovery move, but it arrived about 8.5 minutes after the friction started at 06:30, far past the schema's 2-minute pivot budget.
coaching_implication: Time-box tech troubleshooting attempts to under 2 minutes before defaulting to verbal readback.

quote: So do you and your daughter, do you guys prefer mornings or afternoons?
stewart_read: Rep correctly tries to include the daughter as co-decider, but never speaks with her directly or confirms she'll actually attend — the appointment rests entirely on James relaying details.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may be following standard practice of booking through the primary contact when the co-decider isn't available on the call.
coaching_implication: Ask for the daughter's phone number or have James loop her in by text/call before the appointment to confirm her attendance directly.

stewart_read: The emotional anchor question was never asked; rep never learned why James inquired about solar, losing the strongest lever for tailoring both the bill flip and the close.
coaching_implication: Always ask 'what got you interested in solar' early — even a one-line answer gives material for later curiosity hooks.
